exposure: prolonged second stage (compared with first stage)
outcome: surgical site infections (SSI) following Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS)
cohort: The study included 646 patients who underwent Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS) at ANMMCH, Gaya.
finding: The study identified and categorized host-related, pregnancy and intrapartum-related, and procedure-related factors associated with surgical site infections following LSCS, noting 27 cases of SSI among 646 patients.
